readme.text:
How to read this canvas

- Restaurant web, light theme only (owner decision). Desktop screens are 1440 × 900 and never scroll: long lists scroll inside their own pane, detail opens in panes beside the list, and nothing that is work opens in a modal or sheet.
- Owner only at launch: one login per restaurant, no staff or manager accounts, no restaurant switcher.
- Screens compose the HalalGoes design system (Button, IconButton, Input, Select, Checkbox, Switch, Badge, Card, Menu, AppBar, Countdown, Price, HalalBadge, HalalCertificationPanel). Dashed outlines tagged “Proposed component: …” are composites built from library parts (shadcn/ui on web) and system parts, for the owner to approve into the design system. FileDrop, KeyValueList and SideNav are already approved; Split panes, Collapsible sidebar, Detail panel and the New-orders strip come from the desktop layout rules.
- Dashed blue “Needs API: …” chips mark data the contract lacks (all on Ref-NeedsAPI). Grey mono tags are annotations, not UI.
- Onboarding is server-driven: screens render current_step, progress and review round as returned; the client never works out the next step.
- Sample data: Zaytoun Grill, owner Samir Haddad. Dates are absolute. [support phone] and [support hours] come from the public config.
- Colour uses role tokens from the design system’s tokens.css (recompiled 28 September 2026); no local token overrides.

nA.text:
Sign in

- Every card is a form: Enter submits; on errors focus moves to the summary.
- Session ended or signed out everywhere: say the cost. New orders can’t reach the screen, time out after 3 minutes, and two missed in a row stop new orders.
- Email not confirmed: login returns 401 with email_verification_required = true (only when the password was right). Send a new link is the primary.
- Forgot your password: reset by email is in launch (owner decision; the contract still marks requestPasswordReset and resetPassword a later version). Every sign-in card links to Forgot-Password; the reset row is below the references.
- Two-step sign-in: no recovery codes (owner decision). A lost authenticator is reset only by a super admin, who calls back the phone number on file and matches two account details (owner decision; Needs API).
- One restaurant per login, so there is no restaurant picker.
- Waits use Countdown from Retry-After and the response Date.

tA2.text: Sign in: account states, and the authenticator code (later version: at launch no restaurant is asked for a code)

nC.text:
Register and verify

- A 201 issues no session. The next screen is always Check your email, which has 'Wrong email? Register again with the right one'. The resend label is 'Send a new link' in every state.
- terms_version comes from PublicConfig. The terms document has no URL: Needs API.
- Terms are never pre-ticked; errors are summarised at the top and focus moves there.
- Network/5xx and 429 on register are drawn; retries reuse the Idempotency-Key.
- VERIFICATION_TOKEN_USED has its own screen with Sign in as the primary.
- Restaurant web is desktop and landscape tablet only (owner decision): the phone boards are gone; the 320 px board stays as the 400% zoom check.

tR.text: Forgot your password: reset by email (in launch, owner decision)

nR.text:
Password reset by email

- requestPasswordReset always answers the same way, so Forgot-Sent never says whether the account exists.
- The link works for 30 minutes, once (contract). An expired or used link answers a generic 400: Reset-LinkInvalid (Needs API: a specific code).
- Setting a new password signs out every session, including the order screen, and sends a security email; Reset-Done says to sign in on the order screen again.
- Passwords: at least 12 characters, no composition rules, breached passwords refused (contract).
